mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over any 2-year (60-day) rolling window, the 20-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward movement in the unemployment rate above 6.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE rising above 6.5% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (<0.1%) and strong GDP growth (>2%) signals robust monetary policy support and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS <0.1% and GDPC1 >2%, or are positive when either proxy is not in the expected state.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime marked by low inflation (CPIAUCSL <2.0), accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <0.1%) signals strong growth expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL is below 2.0 in the same month, or are positive when CPIAUCSL is above 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer demand (HOUST) reflects strong economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over a 5-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST increases over the next month, or are positive when HOUST remains flat.

mechanism_narrative: Significant expansion in supply output (INDPRO >105) indicates robust production capacity, which reduces upward pressure on prices and supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises above 105, or are positive when INDPRO does not cross the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong demand growth (GDPC1 >2%) and retail sales momentum (RSAFS >3%) signal robust economic activity, amplifying corporate profits and equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over a 20-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 >2% and RSAFS >3%, or are positive when either proxy is below the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE >6.7%) during a labor market tightening cycle erodes investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over a 20-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises above 6.7% in the next month, or are negative when it does not rise.
